title: Functional inequalities for Boolean entropy
summary: Building on the recently introduced notion of Boolean entropy, we define the corresponding Boolean Fisher information via a de Bruijn identity. We study the monotonicity of this Fisher information in the Boolean Central Limit Theorem and establish several functional inequalities involving these quantities, including a logarithmic Sobolev inequality. We also develop Non-microstate counterparts and prove the associated functional inequalities.
